scope: Cumulative Theme 7 prototype. v3.1.0 redesigns the full Inventory Audit & Control cluster in one pass: BJ08, BJ09, BJ10, BJ11, BJ12, BJ15, BJ16 and BJ17. It aligns queues, product/lot hierarchy, audit history, controlled correction, opening-balance controls, reporting, reconciliation and unknown-result recovery to the live Figma DS while preserving business handlers and journey topology.

figmaRuntime.notes: v3.1.0: full Inventory Audit & Control cluster aligned to live Figma DS. Generic work/case rows hide decorative leading icons and reclaim copy width; product identity retains the product icon. Product and lot/scope data use hierarchy rather than peer cards. Audit history uses DS v2 / Audit Item. Two-choice controls use VRadio, not custom segmented controls. Read-only facts use Info Row/Key-value Row; repeated records use List Row collections. User-facing copy avoids raw technical/English states. No new core DS component is introduced.
